description: Ireland CRO Company Registry Scraper. Look up Irish companies in the official CRO register by name or CRO number. Returns identity, type, status, incorporation date, registered address and email. Directors/shareholders are paid CRO documents and not included. A verified "not found" is a real answer. Advanced fields beyond this schema are also accepted (regdata_describe lists them).

companyNames.description: One or more company names to search, each looked up separately (min 2 characters). Partial names work: every word must appear in the company name, in any order (legal-form words such as 'Ltd' or 'DAC' are optional). Exact and starts-with matches come first, live companies before dissolved ones.
companyNames.title: Company names

companyNumbers.description: One or more Irish CRO registration numbers, each looked up separately. Each must contain digits, e.g. '104547' (a prefix such as 'IE' is ignored). Company numbers only - limited partnership (LP...), reserved name (RN...), society (...R) and trade union (...T) numbers are skipped and not charged.
companyNumbers.title: Company numbers

maxItems.description: Optional cap on billed dataset items returned.

maxResultsPerQuery.description: Maximum company records to export per query (up to 50). When a name matches more companies, the run says so - narrow the name or search by number.
maxResultsPerQuery.title: Max results per query

statusFilter.description: Keep only companies whose status contains one of these words, e.g. 'Normal', 'Dissolved', 'Strike Off Listed', 'Liquidation'. Leave empty to export every match - a Dissolved or Liquidation counterparty is usually the finding you most want to see.
statusFilter.title: Status filter

name: regdata_ireland_cro
